family: joint funding x RV x open-interest interaction family
family_members: member_5 funding_spline = piecewise-linear monotone spline on funding_lag (decile bins at 3/6/9)
member_6 decile_regime = indicator(funding_lag in top/bottom decile) x indicator(rv_lag in top decile)
family_slimming: none; all 6 members tested, family not slimmed

block_3.note: primary block for headline claim (largest clean train set)

common_sample_rule: drop a coin-hour for all models whenever any of rv_lag, funding_lag, oi_change_lag is null; all family members and RV-only scored on identical test rows
outcome: y = 1 if liq_count >= 1 else 0 per (coin, hour); a zero means no event observed in the feed, not a confirmed no-liquidation hour

features.ret_t: ln(close_t / close_{t-1}) within coin, ordered by hour_utc
features.rv_lag: statistics.stdev of trailing 24 hourly log returns ending at t-1 (ret_{t-24..t-1})
features.oi_change_lag: ln(open_interest_usd_{t-1} / open_interest_usd_{t-2}); null if t-2 missing

headline_contrast: each family member vs RV-only baseline on Brier score, block_3 primary
metrics: calibration OLS slope/intercept on test probabilities
placebo: label-hour permutation within hour across coins, 1000 permutations, fixed seed 20261119; empirical p and 95th percentile of null Brier difference per member
multiplicity: Holm over family = {member_1..member_6} x {scored blocks} at alpha=0.05; Holm family declared in prereg before outcomes
verdict_rule_per_member: SUPPORT iff block_3 Brier improvement > 0, p_raw < 0.05, p_holm < 0.05, and placebo 95th percentile < observed improvement; otherwise NOT_MET
overall_verdict: SUPPORT if any member passes; NOT_MET if all powered members fail; UNDERPOWERED if the power gate fails for all
power_gate: recompute MDE from frozen block sizes and panel base rate; PLAUSIBLE_EFFECT_BRIER = 0.001 frozen; if all scored blocks' mde_brier_80pct > 0.001 then status=UNDERPOWERED, models_run=false, honest underpowered artifacts still written
implementation: stdlib only (csv/math/statistics/random/hashlib/datetime/json); logistic regression fit by stdlib IRLS; no scipy/numpy/statsmodels in core path; no pandas/pyarrow reads required (build features from frozen CSV)
data_source: frozen panel research_state/session_20261119T022824Z/fclr_tracka_extension01_panel_session_20261119T022824Z.csv (113,880 coin-hours, 13 coins, 12 months 2025-11..2026-10; extension verdict ADMISSIBLE, frozen)
prohibitions: no sealed Binance months for outcomes
